historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; captures only a short decoded list fragment and does not prove record identity, x/y boundaries or complete descriptor bytes.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds complete list, x/y and bounds validation but lowers capability for pending inputs.

original_test_intent: Verify that each Type 15 record advertises the approved complete ordered set of supported event-log type descriptors, that the list contains exactly x entries of y bytes within the structure, and that it remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Capture the complete raw Type 15 structure and decoded descriptor list, delimit records, validate x/y/table bounds, compare every event-log type and variable-data-format pairing with the approved platform definition, retain unknown extension bytes, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies or approves the descriptor baseline, ordering/duplicate policy and reboot plan. No physical observation or log mutation is intrinsic to this metadata check.
required_inputs: Expected descriptor tuples or approved pattern per Type 15 record
Whether descriptor order is normative and how duplicates are handled
Applicable standard/OEM descriptor layout and treatment of extension bytes
Expected x, y and record-to-log-store mapping
Raw-capable parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read Type 15 metadata only; do not clear, write or inject event logs.
Bound every descriptor by the raw structure length and declared x/y before decoding.
Preserve unknown or OEM extension bytes verbatim and do not invent semantic meanings.
Do not infer support for actual event generation merely from an advertised descriptor.
Stop on malformed boundaries, unsupported format, ambiguous record ownership or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate every descriptor per record, report raw bytes and decoded standard fields, validate x/y/table integrity and compare approved pre/post reboot baselines.
Do not exercise event generation, parse undocumented OEM bytes, mutate logs or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve descriptor content/order/duplicate and OEM-extension policies plus record-to-store mapping.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict from the collected evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The target heading is relevant, but grep -A1 can truncate a multi-entry list and loses record, x, y and raw-boundary context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw and decoded Type 15 output; for each record report handle, structure length, x, y, descriptor index, raw bytes, decoded event-log type, variable-data-format type, extension bytes and bounds result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The descriptor-list scope, Type 15 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing is excluded because it destroys evidence and is unnecessary for this read-only field.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse the full x-by-y descriptor table from raw Type 15 bytes, decode only defined fields, preserve extensions, compare the complete per-record list with the approved baseline and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 15 records that advertise supported event log type descriptors.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, descriptor specification and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 15 supported-descriptor layout, authoritative OEM extension definition if present and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces a one-line decoded grep with record-aware, byte-bounded enumeration of every descriptor and its component fields.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Adds detection of missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, truncated, mis-sized and undecodable descriptor entries.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved descriptor set/order and standard/OEM format.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An advertised descriptor list is capability metadata; it does not prove the platform emits or correctly stores every listed event.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a platform-specific descriptor subset, ordering rule or documented OEM extension, but must version that decision with the matching x/y and firmware baseline; it cannot silently discard unknown entries.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/firmware identity, descriptor set/order/duplicate policy and OEM format
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 15 records with handles, lengths, x, y and all descriptor bytes
Per-entry decoded standard fields, preserved extension bytes and exact count/length/bounds results
Baseline comparison identifying missing, extra, duplicate or reordered entries
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot descriptor-table diff without clearing logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The named list has determinate metadata semantics when evaluated with its same-record count x, descriptor length y and approved platform baseline.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Complete list parsing and comparison are software-automatable after inputs; missing private baselines do not create a permanent block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds complete multi-entry capture, record identity, raw bytes, component fields and x/y bounds.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains format-aware safeguards and no-mutation policy while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification under locked V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates advertised capability metadata from actual event-generation coverage and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a truncated or plausible list fragment from passing when entries are missing, malformed, duplicated, reordered contrary to policy or associated with the wrong Type 15 record.
independent_technical_reasoning: The descriptor table is a finite byte array whose entry count, fixed length, boundaries and standard field values can be deterministically parsed and compared; neither project baseline approval nor final engineering judgment makes its core manual.
